name: DyPO4 xenotime
citation: Y. Ni, J. M. Hughes and A. N. Mariano. Crystal chemistry of the monazite and xenotime structures. American Mineralogist 80 (1995), 21-26.
recommendation: ordered experimental source candidate; native FEFF validation pending
method: Experimental single-crystal X-ray structure refinement with CAD4 and graphite-monochromated Mo K-alpha radiation, independently measured synthetic endmember; original Table 2 reports cell and refined oxygen coordinates.
synthesis_conditions: Synthetic crystals supplied by L. Boatner, Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The paper refers to earlier preparation methods; exact conditions for this crystal are not independently verified here.
notes: Selected the independently refined pure Dy phosphate instead of COD1539592: the inspected oxide paper abstract describes mixed Y/Dy compositions and does not establish an independent pure-endmember refinement.

The crystallographic model is an ordered trivalent reference. FEFF L3 EXAFS paths require experimental validation and do not establish 4f multiplet structure, mixed valence, white-line intensity, calibrated S02, or absolute coordination number. No electronic-state or magnetic accuracy is implied by crystallographic agreement.
All variable coordinates and the unit cell are from this exact downloaded source; no element substitution, coordinate replacement, cell rescaling or symmetrization was written to the CIF.
The raw CIF omits occupancies; parser assumes full occupancy. This is not an explicit occupancy measurement.
